Given that the minor of ${b}_{33}$ is $3$, find all the possible values of $x$ in the matrix

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}6 & -{x}^{2} & -10 \\ -5 & 8 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we remove the third row and third column:

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}6 & -{x}^{2} & ∗ \\ -5 & 8 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The minor of ${b}_{33}$ is

 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}6 & -{x}^{2} \\ -5 & 8\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}6 & -{x}^{2} \\ -5 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =6\cdot 8-(-5)\cdot (-{x}^{2}) \\  & =48-5{x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${b}_{33}$ is $3$, so we must have:

$$
\begin{aligned}48-5{x}^{2} & =3 \\ 45-5{x}^{2} & =0 \\ 9-{x}^{2} & =0 \\ (3-x)(3+x) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=-3$ and $x=3.$
